## 1. Purpose and applicability

Proposed policy for [organization / scope / sites — mandatory before adoption]. We intend to make accountable decisions from identifiable evidence and to retain unresolved matters visibly. This is an original ORR policy, not a reproduction of an external standard's policy commitments.

## 2. Commitments

We will provide a route to raise concerns; identify who may decide and who must receive the result; preserve failed checks and corrected decisions; distinguish work completion from effectiveness; and protect records from unauthorized disclosure or alteration. A leadership decision must remain within its actual authority. This short policy does not replace additional commitments applicable to the organization's selected systems or obligations.

## 3. Accountability and implementation

[Accountable leader] supplies resources and resolves priority conflicts. [Process owner] assigns assessment and follow-up. [Control owner] performs the agreed control and retains evidence. [Reviewer] assesses results within competence and declared conflicts. [Record custodian] controls access and retention. Fill actual appointments and delegation limits before approval.

## 4. Communication and review

Communicate the approved policy through [accessible channels/languages] to affected people; record acknowledgment or understanding evidence appropriate to their tasks. Review on material scope, obligation or failure changes and at [adopted interval]. Escalate absent authority or evidence rather than implying acceptance. Retain approval, communication and review records privately.

## 5. History

r01: original blank learning policy; placeholders are mandatory configuration, not actual commitments or signatures.
